(Nuclear Monster Theme)|250px|center|thumb]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Nuclear Monster''' is the final boss of [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. It has an extremely high amount of health—exceeding the health of every non-event [[Enemies|enemy]] in-game—but has a very slow speed. It is also immune to being frozen by freezing towers, slowed down by the [[Toxic Gunner]], knocked back, damaged through the [[Nuke]] fallout, confused and slowed down by the [[DJ Booth]]. Additionally, it can only be slowed down by the [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] instead of stunned. The '''Nuclear Monster''' replaces the [[Fallen King]] in the [[Oops! All slimes!]] challenge. The '''Nuclear Monster''' has six abilities: #The first ability, ''Nuclear Summon'', summons multiple random enemies. The modern version is not guaranteed to summon anything, while legacy always summons something. This ability for the modern version summons [[Splitter]]s, [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]]s, [[Giant Skeleton]]s, [[Mutagenic Blight]]s and [[Rusher]]s. legacy version can spawn the [[Toxic]], [[Super Toxic]], [[Slime]], [[Circuit (Polluted Wasteland II)|Circuit]], [[Abomination]], [[Amalgamation]], [[Rusher]], [[Cursed Skeleton]], [[Shadow Boss]], [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] and [[Super Mutant]]. It can only spawn one [[Abomination]], and up to three [[Amalgamation]]s and [[Rusher]]s when using the ability, though it cannot summon an [[Abomination]] when near the exit. #The second ability is ''Boxing Knockout'', where the '''Nuclear Monster''' will charge up its right hand and then punch the ground with it, creating a large shockwave that stuns any tower hit by it and deals 500 damage to units. #The third ability is ''Acid Eruption'', where the '''Nuclear Monster''' will hold its chest and start shaking uncontrollably, shooting out multiple acidic balls onto the map, stunning any tower caught in their radius and dealing 120 damage to units. #The fourth ability is ''Nuclear Beam'', in which '''Nuclear Monster''' will fire a green energy beam from its chest that stuns any tower caught in it. #The fifth ability is ''Blindly Shooting'', where the '''Nuclear Monster''' will howl into the air, which decreases the range of all towers by 15% with the [[Scared Debuff]] and damages units by 400. This ability is most often performed alongside the ''Nuclear Summon'' ability. #The last ability is ''Nuclear Meltdown'', a rage mode ability, where the '''Nuclear Monster''' will stomp three times, use the ''Blindly Shooting'' ability and then use a random ability. It will then become faster and gain a green outline. Legacy's ''Nuclear Summon'' ability will also lose the ability to summon [[Amalgamation]]s, [[Abomination]]s and [[Super Toxic]]s. ==Appearance== The '''Nuclear Monster''' is a robotic monster with a bull-shaped mask, green devil horns, green skin and a red head. It has mechanical hands as well as a mechanical bull mask with glowing green horns and eyes. Its torso is cut open, there being a grey robotic heart with a green glowing core, which can be used to fire green beams. It also has grey shoulder-pads, an energy pack on its back and numerous green humanoids sticking out of its body. The '''Nuclear Monster''' has a death animation, where it will convulse and emit sparks, before all of its green lights turn a dark grey as it falls to its knees and then forward. ==Strategy== *Multiple high DPS towers, such as the [[Engineer]], [[Accelerator]], [[Pursuit]], [[Golden Minigunner]] and [[Turret]] are needed to eliminate the '''Nuclear Monster'''. **The [[Pursuit]] is immune to both stuns and debuffs, making it unaffected by all of the '''Nuclear Monster's''' abilities. **The [[Ranger]] is immune to stuns, making it very useful against the '''Nuclear Monster'''. **As the '''Nuclear Monster''' will apply the [[Scared Debuff]] quite often, the [[Turret]] can be effective here because of its debuff immunity, though it is not stun immune. *The [[Commander]] and [[Mercenary Base]] are highly recommended to boost the firerate and damage of your towers. *The [[DJ Booth]] is extremely useful at increasing your tower's range due to how big the map is, keeping the '''Nuclear Monster''' in range for longer and partially mitigating the ''Blindly Shooting'' ability. **It cannot slow down the '''Nuclear Monster''' as it is a boss enemy. *The [[Medic]] is extremely useful at shield towers from the stuns caused by the '''Nuclear Monster'''. **Do note that the [[Medic]] cannot shield towers from the [[Scared Debuff]] applied by it. *Freezing towers like [[Freezer]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Sledger]] can only slow down the '''Nuclear Monster''' as it is immune to freeze. **The [[Toxic Gunner]] cannot slow down the '''Nuclear Monster''' as it is immune to its slowing effect. **The [[Electroshocker]] and [[Warden]] can slow down the '''Nuclear Monster''' instead of completely stopping it, though the [[Warden]] can only slow it down for a shorter amount of time due to its large size. ***Multiple [[Electroshocker]]s boosted by the [[Commander]] can be somewhat effective at slowing down the '''Nuclear Monster''' and the enemies it summons. **The [[Jester]]'s confusion bombs cannot confuse the '''Nuclear Monster''', but it can still slow it down with its ice bombs. ==Sounds== {{Sounds|{{pe| {| class{{=}}"article-table align-center"
